lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mn6Co8S16 (reduced formula Mn3(CoS2)4) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 30 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Co centers in octahedral environments with six S neighbors at 2.362 Å, while Mn centers show eight S neighbors at 2.591 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 30 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Co octahedra and corner-sharing between Co octahedra and Mn 8-vertex polyhedra.
